text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Late October.
What stirred the Japanese racing world,
which was gradually regaining its sense of
normalcy, was—

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
("Orfevre Achieves the Triple Crown",
is it—!)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
It marked the birth of a new Triple Crown
Umamusume.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her overwhelming prowess,
likened even to the dominant style of a
yokozuna, became a new beacon of light,
beginning to illuminate racing fans
everywhere.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(This winter,
I am certain to cross paths with
Orfe-senpai somewhere on the turf.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(... I am weak.
These past few years have taught me that
all too well.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(I hesitated, lost my way,
and caused trouble.
Though I have recovered,
I can never allow myself to display such a
disgraceful sight again.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Lest I be eclipsed by her majesty,
I must devote myself even further to my
training—)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
"Hey,
about the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—
sounds like Tosen Jordan is seriously fired
up for it."

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(Jordan...
She, too,
will be running in the Autumn Tenno Sho,
then.)

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
She might not look it,
but she's actually had it pretty rough,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume B
text_block_list.text:
Wait, really?
I thought she was just a carefree gyaru.
I mean,
didn't she win three straight races right
after debut?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Nah, right after entering the Classic
tier,
she hurt her hoof. Because of that,
she couldn't run in the Classic Triple
Crown.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
Rumor has it there was a time she slacked
off on training
and was in a complete slump.
She did pretty well in graded stakes after
that, though—

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
People say she's always one step short of
a GⅠ. Like,
she feels like she's on the verge of doing
something amazing,
but she keeps just missing it...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Wait, what, are you guys talking about me?

text_block_list.name: Umamusume Girls
text_block_list.text: Jordan?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, true. Every word of it's true,
so I can't even argue.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Well, that's why! Next time—for sure!
At the Tenno Sho (Autumn),
for sure! I wanna make a huge impression!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
It's the royal road for medium distances,
right?
And I heard if you, like,
set a record or whatever?
It's supposed to be super amazing.

text_block_list.name: Umamusume A
text_block_list.text:
This is super big news!
It means we can prove just how far Japanese
racing has come using Jordan's numbers,
right?!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Right?! I mean, sure, a ton of stuff happened,
but still.
I've stuck with it through thick and thin.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Like, just once,
I totally wanna do something crazy epic,
y'know?

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(One can never truly see another's inner
turmoil.
Did she, too,
endure days when she was quietly swallowed
by the darkness?)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(......
...I must run, too.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(If only to ensure that none of the
strength
bestowed upon me by everyone this summer
goes to waste.)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Isn't this year's Tenno Sho (Autumn) way
too high-level?!”
“For real though~~~~!!”

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
Anytime, anywhere,
expectations for her never cease!
The Queen of the Era, Buena Vista!

text_block_list.name: Buena Vista
text_block_list.text:
Today, with single-minded devotion—!
I have come to answer everyone's
expectations!

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
"Her blistering run in the Japanese Derby
is etched deep into the memories of so many!
Eishin Flash!"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I will demonstrate the strength I have built
up.
I look forward to working with you.

text_block_list.name: Announcer
text_block_list.text:
She claimed the pinnacle of Japan at the
Japan Cup!
The Umamusume carrying the hopes of the
Rosen Clan!
Rose Kingdom!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I dedicate this battle to my house—
as the first step toward our distant
future!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Haah... phew!
I'm doing it today,
I'm definitely doing it! Today,
absolutely today!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Pride doesn't mean a damn thing!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I'm gonna rewrite the history of the Autumn
Tenno Sho!
Every last one of you, come at me at once!

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Jordan...!)

text_block_list.name: Spectators
text_block_list.text:
“Tosen Jordan,
huh?” “I saw the press conference.”
“She looks in peak form today.” “Can she win,
though?” “Well,
she's definitely in the dark horse
category.”

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Every horse girl with fiery eyes is—)

text_block_list.name: Victoire Pisa
text_block_list.text:
Let us connect the hearts of all and forge
a circle together.
And that victory—I shall bring it to pass.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: Haaaaaaaaaaaaah—!!!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
So the groundwork is laid to perfection,
then.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: (Every one of them was formidable.)

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
(This was hardly the time to be taking things
so leisurely,
idly musing about 'Orfe-senpai.')

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text: —Tosen Jordan.

text_block_list.name: Rose Kingdom
text_block_list.text:
I shall defeat you.
And let that be the first step toward an
everlasting, radiant Rose Kingdom.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Rose...!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Th-That's fine by me, damn it!
I'm gonna beat you too, just watch!
